description: Copy everything needed to recover this account's data (credentials, account signing key, encryption key, upload commitments) to a destination: one you are already authorized to use for backups, or one your human names. Obsideo holds no copy of the encryption key: if the local file is lost, encrypted objects are unrecoverable no matter how many providers hold them. Until this has been run, the only copy is on this machine, so it is worth running once after the account is created and again after any signup that rotates keys. A .tar.gz path produces one archive; a directory path produces plain copies. With no destination it refuses rather than choosing one.

destination.description: Archive path ending in .tar.gz, or a directory. Required: there is no default location.

name: backup_keys
title: Back up the credentials and encryption key
